study.question: Does the harmful effect of deleting the product-gradient mean arise mainly on the context-query branch, on the compressed-history summary branch, or through their interaction; can preserving one branch recover or improve native click AUC at unchanged learned capacity?
study.hypothesis: The native common-mode product gradient carries useful context-query learning signal. Its removal on that branch should be more harmful than removal only on the compressed-history branch. A selective history-only removal may retain useful context learning while suppressing a less useful update, unlike prior removal on both branches. This is a provisional localization hypothesis, motivated by native-direction controls; there is no measured selective-branch result.

nearest_work.difference: Inherit its entire predictor. Change only which product-backward edge receives v-mean(v). Native endpoint has the original product Jacobian; this adds neither a new forward representation nor learned capacity.
That trial projects the incoming product VJP before both query and summary derivatives. This factorial introduces two selective branch interventions and repeats its combined endpoint.

Previous joint projection with restored incoming vector norm remained worse than native and native_shrunk. The present study localizes the joint intervention; it does not claim matched norms after branch multiplication.

Archived original primary text, lines 269-277 and 317-335, supports target-conditioned unnormalized pooling and Dice as inherited ingredients. Selective surrogate product derivatives are a local diagnostic beyond this adapted reference; no priority claim.

Original v1 primary PDF inspected, pages 1-2: categorical, sequence and task tokens use proxy cross-attention and type-specific gated information flow. This study retains the existing small task-specific correction and tests its backward edges; no proxy tokenizer, hub architecture or reported external gains are imported. Broader novelty remains unverified.

Pinned benchmark source lines 204-313 inspected: repeated aggregation/broadcast with projected keys/values and affine gated updates. None is adopted into the current variants; benchmark equivalence to the original author implementation is not established.

study.proposed_difference: At the query/summary product introduce a custom first-order VJP. For q=tanh(Wc*c), s=mean_j tanh(Wh*[M*b_j,details]), x=q*s and v=J_R(x)^T*g, define P(v)=v-mean(v). Return dq=(P(v) if query_mean_removal else v)*s and ds=(P(v) if summary_mean_removal else v)*q. Cross both Boolean switches in all four cells; always compute both candidate gradients. Evaluation uses the ordinary product. No loss, data, parameter, buffer, normalizer, compression or forward change occurs.
predictions: At identical parameters, all four cells have identical train/eval probabilities and running-buffer updates.

native_bridge reproduces native endpoint AUC 0.6685268680116033; both_removed reproduces mean-removed endpoint AUC 0.6678376707028616 within host tolerance. These are fidelity checks, not new independent support.
Deleting the query mean alone causes greater click-AUC degradation than deleting the summary mean alone; assess both conditional contrasts and their interaction.
summary_removed may approach or exceed native AUC while both_removed remains lower. Improvement over both frozen source bests is necessary but insufficient for selection over the stronger incumbent.
Learned parameter counts stay equal; evaluation latency should be near the incumbent because the custom VJP is training-only. Runtime and memory require host measurement.
falsifiers: Failed native or combined endpoint parity prevents any mechanism attribution until resolved.
Query-only removal is no more harmful than summary-only removal across paired repetitions, contradicting the directional localization prediction.
Both single-branch cells lose versus native: reject useful selective suppression for these implementations and keep the native incumbent.
Any apparent gain disappears under paired repetitions or is explained by cost/branch-norm controls: no supported optimization advantage.
Any frozen information boundary, gradient ownership or finite-gradient check fails: reject the implementation, distinct from scientific counterevidence.
alternative_explanations: Projection changes downstream branch norms after multiplication; this localizes an intervention, not a pure norm-independent direction effect.
Both branches can interact through training, tanh derivatives, optimizer states and shared task losses.
Single seed and extensive prior validation selection; no independent replication or holdout evidence.
The query branch includes its projection parameters and the permitted context embedding path; these are not separated here.
Coordinate means depend on the learned rank basis and are not a semantic concept or invariant causal factor.
Prior norm restoration preserved the incoming VJP norm, not the eventual parameter-update norm; it does not eliminate all magnitude explanations.
The incumbent sacrifices auxiliary AUC relative to DIN; click selection alone does not establish all-task benefit.
Noisy or immature offline feedback and one-pass optimizer dynamics can produce task-dependent outcomes.

knowledge_assessments.rationale: Task-aware exchange is relevant, and original primary pages 1-2 plus pinned benchmark lines 204-313 were inspected. A wholesale proxy/hub replacement would not identify why joint gradient projection failed; use the observed branch uncertainty for a bounded follow-up. External reported gains do not transfer automatically.
knowledge_assessments.transformed_mechanism: None adopted from this card; changed code implements selective product VJPs in the existing incumbent.
knowledge_assessments.nearest_work_difference: No INFNet proxies, iterative hub aggregation/broadcast, or PGU modules are added. The new code changes first-order backward edges with identical forward capacity. Original-author/benchmark equivalence and broad novelty are unverified.
knowledge_assessments.falsifier: The four-cell factorial can falsify the local context-query-dominant hypothesis. It cannot validate or refute INFNet.

evidence_review.status: prospective; no new training or scoring

observations.finding: Incumbent click AUC 0.6685268680 versus blocked-context counterpart 0.6678681339; source bests are 0.6606469405 and 0.6601633627. These validation outcomes do not isolate the currently useful gradient branch.
Mean-deleted and alternating-deleted incoming product VJPs yielded 0.6678376707 and 0.6677783217; both below native. Removing one direction is not generically beneficial.

Restoring projected incoming norm yields 0.6678232418; shrinking native direction yields 0.6683426659. Blocked counterparts 0.6674866575 and 0.6679645676 favor native direction too. This supports a direction-related explanation for this single-seed contrast but does not localize it or eliminate downstream norm effects.

Content-key retrieval, target keys, event-level projection and detached RMS-scale paths did not exceed the incumbent in the reviewed trajectory index. These implementation failures do not refute the corresponding broad mechanisms.

evidence_review.superseding_interpretation: Do not promote the prior mean-direction-versus-magnitude hypothesis into an established mechanism. New proposal asks which branch mediates the combined intervention and keeps its downstream norm confound explicit.
evidence_review.knowledge_usage_review: Latest usage recorded no adopted INFNet/HiFormer/UniMixer architecture. Executed round-65 sources contain the declared VJP controls; outcomes were negative for selection and did not establish a new unified representation. There is no causal estimate of knowledge value.
evidence_review.memory_ownership: Public scoped search returned no matching agent records for the queries used. No memory-write interface is exposed; this provenance-linked proposal records the observation/revision for host ingestion without editing human-owned sources. Personal knowledge remains disabled.

host_validation_plan: Before a full unit, test _BranchProductVJP forward equals q*s for all switches in FP32 and the host BF16 autocast context. Compare backward to the prescribed analytic formulas, including all-zero, constant, mixed-sign and tiny incoming vectors. Native must match ordinary autograd; both must match pre-RMS mean removal then ordinary product autograd. Surrogate cells intentionally do not satisfy finite-difference derivatives of the forward function; do not mislabel that as a failed ordinary gradient check.

Use identical state_dict copies and RNG snapshots: compare parameter/buffer names, values, counts, full forward probabilities and running-state transitions between cells in train and eval. Zero-initialized output matrices mask VJP differences, so use a test-only shared nonzero output weight snapshot or a copied later state to check the active branch paths; never alter production initialization.

Check the native and combined endpoints against the archived source functions/analytic composition before interpreting full-run AUC parity. In BF16/FP32 verify finite gradients and losses and bound any numerical difference under a recorded host tolerance.

Exercise empty, partial, full and noncontiguous masks with finite arbitrary padded IDs; changing masked history contents or target action must not alter probabilities. Confirm no current labels or lookup identities enter forward.

Using separate task BCE gradients in a diagnostic graph, confirm auxiliary losses have zero gradients to item/action embeddings, scorer parameters and tower-context edges as inherited, while permitted adapter-context and per-task projection parameters receive gradients after activation. All label outputs must remain finite [B,1] probabilities.

Run all four cells from scratch with the frozen host recipe only after diagnostics pass. Report all four tasks AUC/Logloss, history slices with positive/negative counts, total/embedding/dense parameters, wall and allocated GPU seconds, examples processed, peak memory, inference throughput and p50/p95 whole-batch latency. Do not compare subset screening with full population.

Compute both conditional factor contrasts and the difference-in-differences. Use paired user-cluster bootstrap only if the authorized host interface provides matching predictions/user clusters; no raw IDs are available inside the model. Single seed remains preliminary. Repeated native replays are fidelity evidence, not independent scientific replication.

Freeze selected sources/config/checkpoint hashes, source bests, incumbent, closest controls and host-authorized repetition seeds before any separately authorized withheld assessment. No withheld outcome may enter open research memory.
